description: Fixed three-hour mission horizon with final scoring from surviving landed red ground-force HP inside one kilometer of blue_base.

capture_success.description: Capture remains a process event and reward source; it does not terminate the episode.

fixed_horizon.description: Terminate at three simulation hours and score landed surviving red ground-force HP within 1 km of blue_base.

red_ground_defeated.description: All red ground forces are destroyed; terminate early with zero final score.

red_transport_no_army_no_landing.description: Disabled under the fixed-horizon scoring contract.

red_attack_aircraft_defeated_before_land.description: Disabled under the fixed-horizon scoring contract.

timeout.description: Optional non-live fallback only; live termination uses AFSIM simulation time.
